evidence.summary: The UN Security Council listed Rah Sahel in resolution 1929 (2010), among the entities owned, controlled or acting on behalf of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), as owned or controlled by, or acting on behalf of, Khatam al-Anbiya Construction Headquarters (KAA). The resolution describes KAA as an IRGC-owned company that carries out large civil and military construction projects. OFAC lists it as Rah Sahel Institute, in Tehran, under its IRGC sanctions programme, among others.
The UN Security Council lists it as owned or controlled by, or acting on behalf of, Khatam al-Anbiya Construction Headquarters, a company owned by Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).

sources.title: Resolution 1929 (2010), adopted by the Security Council on 9 June 2010 (S/RES/1929 (2010)), Annex II
